title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
problem_statement: VB6 legacy code contains unparameterized SQL queries vulnerable to injection attacks
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical security vulnerability allowing unauthorized data access and manipulation
suggested_approach: Replace all string concatenation SQL with parameterized queries using Entity Framework or Dapper in C#
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized approach
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in database operations

title: Create VB6 to C# Event Handler Mapping
problem_statement: VB6 event handlers need precise behavioral mapping to C# equivalents
risk_if_unaddressed: Loss of critical business logic and user interaction patterns
suggested_approach: Create comprehensive mapping document and automated conversion templates
success_criteria: All VB6 events mapped to C# equivalents
Conversion templates available for common patterns

title: Complete Database Schema Analysis
problem_statement: Source database schema unknown, creating migration planning gaps
risk_if_unaddressed: Data integrity issues and incomplete migration
suggested_approach: Use database reverse engineering tools to extract complete schema and data relationships

title: Replace ADO Recordsets with Modern Data Access
problem_statement: ADO recordset patterns are obsolete and need modern replacement
suggested_approach: Implement Entity Framework Core with PostgreSQL provider
success_criteria: All ADO recordsets replaced with EF Core
